title: Undeciphered figures printed in the Mémoires et correspondance de Duplessis-Mornay (1824): Loménie 1595, Duplessis 1597-98 (the 1593 Du Maurier/Serviez figures are read)
correspondents: Du Maurier, J. de Serviez, Loménie → Philippe Duplessis-Mornay; Duplessis-Mornay → various
shelfmark: Mémoires et correspondance de Duplessis-Mornay (Paris 1824-25) vol. 5 pp. 471-475, 487-488; vol. 6 pp. 179-181; vols. 7-8 (archive.org mmoiresetcorre05morn etc.)
folio_note: 1593: 8 passages, 93 groups (targets/mornay1593/ciphertext.txt). Mme de Rohan 1594 (vol. 6 LVI) is printed with its decipherment, a key for the household.
status: The 1824 editors printed these figures because they had no key (vol. 6 p. 82 n. 1). Web search found no later decipherment. Attempted 25 Oct 2026: two-letters-per-group anneal failed (targets/mornay1593/). Originals possibly AN 402AP or Institut Mornay papers. 27 Oct 2026, Brice Dudout (email): the 1593 figures read (folded alphabet; our two-letters-per-group hypothesis, credited); Du Maurier's letter is Tuesday 20 July 1593, not June. Entry narrowed to the 1595-98 figures.
why: Henri IV's conversion summer of 1593 seen from Duplessis-Mornay's correspondents; no archive request needed, page images online, and a sibling key (Rohan 1594) in the same edition.
source: Printed edition (found during the Archives nationales sweep, 25 Oct 2026)
prior_art: partial: 1593 figures read by Brice Dudout, Europe chiffrée (https://bdudout.github.io/europe-chiffree/en/documents.html#mornay-1593), Oct 2026
known: Rohan 1594 letter deciphered in print. The 1593 Du Maurier and Serviez figures (vol. 5, 93 groups) read by Brice Dudout, 27 Oct 2026: two letters per group on a folded alphabet (a 2, c-m odd 5-21 rising, n-u even 22-8 falling); applied here to the project's transcription, 93/93 groups (targets/mornay1593/).
open: Loménie 24 Feb 1595 and Duplessis Jan 1597 (transcribed, a different system; the Rohan key does not fit); later 1597 and 1598 figures in vols. 7-8 not transcribed.

title: Philip IV → the marquis of Velada, ambassador extraordinary in England: two short cipher runs
correspondents: Philip IV of Spain (countersigned Andrés de Rozas) → Antonio Sancho Dávila, marquis of Velada
shelfmark: Koninklijk Huisarchief, The Hague, Collectie Handschriften 2e serie, G016-A0572
folio_note: 7 scans (KHA image ids 96169-96174); two cipher runs of about 20 and 25 groups, both ending '121 so ta na te 6 Q X'
status: Viewed 25 Oct 2026: clear Spanish recalling Velada to Flanders, with two short cipher runs (figures 4-171, signs, syllables), no decipherment, nothing on the dorse, no print found. Too short for a break; needs the 1640 Velada/Malvezzi cifra (Simancas, Estado, Inglaterra). 27 Oct 2026: assessment confirmed, too short to break without the key; the 1640 England papers of Simancas (Estado, Inglaterra) are not on PARES.
why: The cipher runs are the secret part of the order recalling Velada from London in the year of the Catalan and Portuguese revolts.
outcome: attempted, open: blocked, too short without the key; the 1640 Simancas Estado Inglaterra papers are not on PARES (27 Oct 2026)

shelfmark: ANTT, Miscelâneas Manuscritas do Convento da Graça, tomo 1E (PT/TT/MMCG/1E)
status: 9 letters grouped. DigitArq: 'Carta de D. Fernando Teles de Faro a D. Francisco de Melo em cifra'; no decipherment noted.
